call_points.text: Ahmedabad and Kolkata sorting centres to be built this year, automation ramped by H1FY28.
Q4FY26 volume was 267,000 tons, up 4% YoY; FY26 crossed 1 million tons at 1,004,000.
Analysts pressed on four years of flat total income and PAT margin falling to 7.2% from 11.2%; management called it a demand-supply cycle.
Surface Express remained the largest contributor supported by automotive, defense, solar, EV, SME, and pharma segments.
Rail Express recorded a growth of 35% in Q4 FY26 driven by corridor expansion and scalable operations.

penalties.impact: A fine of ₹14,000 was paid at the Mayo Hall Court, as directed by the Hon’ble Court. The matter has been settled and stands closed.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: A demand order has been issued under Section 74(1) of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 (“CGST Act”) for the period from FY 2017–18 to FY 2021–22, aggregating to ₹51,36,02,450 (along with applicable interest and penalty). The said demand primarily arises due to differences in interpretation of certain provisions of the CGST Act and the underlying transactions. The Company has contested the aforesaid demand and accordingly filed an appeal, where the Office of the Commissioner (Appeals), Central Goods and Services Tax, Gurugram Commissionerate, rejected our appeal vide its order dated January 14, 2026, and held that the Order-in-Original continues to remain in force.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Office of the Commissioner (Appeals) of Central Goods and Service Tax, Gurugram Commissionerate
tax_litigation.status: The Company proposes to file a further appeal before the appropriate GST appellate authority against the said order and remains confident of its position based on the merits of the case.

timeline.summary: CRISIL Ratings reaffirmed TCI Express's credit rating at CRISIL AA-/Stable on ₹100 Cr total bank loan facilities.
Dharmpal Agarwal confirmed no encumbrance on 26,687,662 TCI Express shares held by promoter group as of March 31, 2026.
TCI Express Limited postponed its Q4 FY26 results conference call due to an extended Board Meeting, as informed by **Priyanka (Company Secretary & Compliance Officer)** on May 27, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹328.08 Cr (+6.8% YoY), net profit ₹16.03 Cr (-17.2% YoY).
TCI Express reported Q4 FY26 standalone total income of ₹331.1 Cr and PAT of ₹20.8 Cr.
TCI Express Limited uploaded the audio recording of its Q4/FY 2025-26 analyst/investor conference call on May 29, 2026, at its website.

On the 29 May 2026 Q4FY26 call, TCI Express guided FY27 revenue growth of 15%-plus and volume growth of 10-11%, with EBITDA margin up 100-150 bps, and cut its FY23-FY27 capex plan to ₹400 Cr from ₹500 Cr.
TCI Express Q1FY27 results: revenue up 9% YoY to ₹315 Cr, E-commerce Express up 63% YoY; FY27 guidance: volume growth 11-12%, PAT growth 20-25%

watchlist.target: 15%+ for FY27; high single digit in Q1

watchlist.response: Chander Agarwal attributed it to a five-year demand-supply cycle after COVID and said growth would return in time; no specific recovery timeline given.
watchlist.text: Four years of flat total income and PAT margin down to 7.2% from 11.2% despite sorting-centre modernisation

watchlist.response: Mukti Lal cited airline consolidation, ATF up 50%, airport privatisation, lower truck utilisation and labour cost up 100 bps; guided FY27 revenue up 15% and margin up 100-150 bps.
watchlist.text: Volume growth stuck in mid-single digits for 7-8 quarters and margins down to 10-11% from 15-16%

watchlist.response: Management said April was not as bad as feared and May is going well, expecting high single digit in Q1 and improvement through the year.
watchlist.text: Whether the 10% volume guidance is achievable after lost growth in April-May

watchlist.response: Management declined, saying international volumes are unpredictable and rail is a niche segment; would disclose once sizable.
